task: Make the text in a scanned PDF selectable and searchable
packaging_note: Runs OCRmyPDF's official v17.13.0 multi-platform image by digest.

settings.name: OCR_LANGUAGE
settings.what: the language printed on the pages
settings.how: Use an installed Tesseract code, such as eng, fra, deu, spa, por or chi_sim.

outputs.what: your PDF with a searchable text layer

known_issues: English is the default. Password-protected documents must be unlocked first.
